description: This file defines a Perl class 'Coocook::Script::Dbck' which implements a script for checking and fixing database integrity issues, specifically for SQLite databases. It includes methods for schema validation, relationship consistency, numeric value checks, and other database integrity verifications, with optional automatic fixing.

classes.name: Coocook::Script::Dbck
classes.description: A Perl class implementing a database integrity check and repair script for SQLite databases within the Coocook project.

methods.name: run
methods.description: Main method executing all database checks in sequence.

methods.name: check_schema
methods.description: Verifies that the database schema matches the expected schema for SQLite.

methods.name: check_relationships
methods.description: Checks referential integrity and consistency of relationships between tables.

methods.name: check_sqlite_numeric_values
methods.description: Checks for invalid numeric values and empty strings in SQLite tables.

methods.name: check_fc_values
methods.description: Checks for duplicate or inconsistent 'name_fc' fields in organizations and users.

methods.name: check_url_name_values
methods.description: Verifies correctness of URL-friendly name fields in projects.

methods.name: check_unit_conversions_values
methods.description: Ensures unit conversions are normalized and fixes them if needed.

methods.name: check_missing_default_purchase_lists
methods.description: Checks for projects with purchase lists but missing default purchase list IDs.

methods.name: check_unassigned_dish_ingredients
methods.description: Detects dish ingredients that are unassigned or orphaned.

methods.name: check_items_without_dish_ingredients
methods.description: Finds items that are not associated with any dish ingredients.

methods.name: check_items_values
methods.description: Validates item values against computed expected values based on ingredients and unit conversions.

methods.name: _debug
methods.description: Outputs debug information if debugging is enabled.
